notes.title: Steam Page Update & Devlogs
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

It’s been a while since Twisted Waters Steam page was up and it was in need of a refresh. The game is still in active development so the page is also a work-in-progress. There will be more updates about all the cool things in the game. But for now, please enjoy the new art and more screenshots to see what the game looks like right now.

Also, a second devlog is on its way so this would be a great moment to refresh your memory of how Twisted Waters used to look when it was announced in the first devlog.
